producer_report.summary: The `decisions` source was empty because no file is committed under `records/decision-states` or `records/default-expectations` at the head commit. It was not a copy bug. `GitView::workspace` in `steward.rs` writes every file `RecordSet::load` (`athena-gate/src/records.rs`) finds under `records/`, then creates any missing source directory as empty. A decision-state record is only written when the watcher sees a landing signal (`watch_landing`), and a default-expectations record only by `record_default_expectations`. D84 is design text in `docs/decisions.md`, not a record. So the code already makes `decisions` readable whenever such a record exists. I did not change behavior. I wrote the cause down in `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/records.md`, and added a comment at the empty-directory step in `steward.rs`. I also added a unit test, `the_decisions_source_holds_decision_records_when_committed_and_is_an_empty_directory_when_not`. It builds a scratch repo with a decision-state record and checks the file appears in the workspace. It then builds a repo without one and checks both source directories exist and hold no files.

criteria_check.criterion: The change writes down the cause of the empty `decisions` source in a committed file (CHANGELOG.md or docs/records.md), citing the code path (crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs and crates/athena-gate/src/records.rs) that produces the empty directory. A reader can check this with git diff.
criteria_check.evidence: CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased/Fixed) and docs/records.md (new subsection 'When the steward's decisions source is empty') state the cause and cite steward.rs `GitView::workspace` and gate `records.rs` `RecordSet::load`.

criteria_check.criterion: Either the diff changes crates/athena-core/src/steward.rs (or the record writer) so the steward's workspace holds decision records when they exist at HEAD, with a test in the same crate that builds a view containing a decision-state record and asserts the file appears under the decisions source paths, or the committed notes state why decisions cannot be read and what would change that.
criteria_check.evidence: The workspace already copies committed decision records, so the code needed no behavior change. The diff adds a steward.rs test that builds a GitView over a repo with a decision-state record and asserts the file is in the workspace. The notes say what would change an empty source.

criteria_check.criterion: A test that the decisions source is populated when a decision-state record exists in the view and stays an empty directory when none exists; run `cargo test -p athena-core steward` and it passes.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core steward` ran 19 passed, 0 failed, including the new decisions test.

open_issues: Whether the real repository has any decision-state or default-expectations records committed could not be checked from the snapshot. If decision records are meant to exist for decisions like D84, a separate change would need to add a writer for them.
learnings: records/ is absent from the producer snapshot, so I could not confirm directly that no decision records are committed. The cause is inferred from the code paths: nothing in `GitView::workspace` drops committed files.
Decision-state records come only from `watch_landing`, and default-expectations records only from `record_default_expectations`; neither is written when a decision is merely made.
D84 is a heading in docs/decisions.md, not a record.
